# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column by removing commas and converting to float

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
filtered_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

total_revenue = filtered_orders['revenue'].sum()
